ReductionDsl: a costed deep embedding for game reductions

Trusted in part. Every definition in this file except the variable shorthands Expr.v0 to Expr.v6 is part of the trusted base (Computational/docs/TRUSTED_BASE.md): a reduction named by a headline statement is a CostedReduction or TwoStageCostedReduction value whose efficiency claims use totalCost, totalQueries, size, and the per-query-kind cost definitions (Expr.costAt, Comp.pureEval?, Comp.costAt, ValidKindCosts, totalCostByKind, CostBoundedByKind). The auxiliary size, table-cost, and dual-fuel definitions (Ty.BaseFits, OpsBaseBounded, SampBaseBounded, Ty.listDepth, Ty.NoNestedLists, Ty.HasNoTbl, Ty.treeBlocks, Expr.costWithTbl, Comp.costWithTbl, GameCodec.FitsOn, GameCodec.BaseFitsOn, CostedReduction.totalCostBounded, TwoStageCostedReduction.run1Bounded, runFuelBounded, TwoStageCostedReduction.eval1Bounded, TwoStageCostedReduction.eval2Bounded, TwoStageCostedReduction.totalCostBounded) are proof-support definitions outside every headline's closure.

ReductionDsl is the first-order language in which security reductions of the computational proof stack are written. It defines pure expressions (Expr) over inspectable data types (unit, bool, nat, opt, prod, sum, list, tbl) and opaque abstract sorts S.Base accessed solely through declared operation tables (Ops); monadic programs (Comp) with coin-only Samplers, target-game oracle queries (Iface), and statically bounded loops; interpretation into VCVio OracleComp (Expr.eval, Comp.eval); structural and input-specialized step-cost, query, and syntax-size measures (cost, costAt, queries, size); and single- and two-stage transducers (CostedReduction, TwoStageCostedReduction) over source-game codecs (GameCodec). Shared operation tables, uniform samplers, and target codecs live in AtomicOps.lean, Samplers.lean, and Computational/Specifications/Reductions/ReductionDsl/TargetCodecs.lean; see Computational/docs/REDUCTION_DSL_TUTORIAL.md.

The efficiency model rests on five invariants:

  1. Sort opacity and table honesty. Expr eliminates .base b only via Expr.op. Each table entry O.cost o bounds the work of O.eval o up to O.cost o × (max input blocks) under block measure S.sz and satisfies OpsSizeHonest; each query tag's I.qCost covers reading its argument and answer, I.uCost covers one forwarded uniform coin draw, and each coin-only sampler's constant I.smp.sCost bounds output width (SampSizeHonest). Reductions use only shared Ops, Samplers, Iface, and GameCodec tables.

  2. Bounded value growth. Every value-growing constructor pays at least its output growth in blocks, bit-length, or list length, so run values stay within input size plus step cost plus a run-local oracle-answer bound (Comp.fits_eval in Computational/Proofs/ReductionDsl/Size.lean).

  3. Single-pass black-box execution. CostedReduction.eval executes the adversary A once via simulateQ without rewinding (TwoStageCostedReduction pauses A at most once at a challenge query and resumes its continuation in stage 2), so totalCost and totalQueries bound work outside A and target queries (Computational/Proofs/ReductionDsl/Soundness.lean).

  4. Syntax-size bound. Because branch cost takes max over arms, step cost alone allows a depth-d decision tree to embed a 2 ^ d-entry non-uniform lookup table. Headline boundedness predicates therefore also require size ≤ reductionSizeBudget (2 ^ 24 syntax nodes; both branch arms, numeric literal bit-lengths, Ops.opSize literal payloads, and each loop body count once).

  5. Input-specialized per-kind cost. Expr.costAt and Comp.costAt charge branches only for the arm selected at ρ (computed via Expr.eval), and Comp.bind specializes its continuation only after an effect-free prefix (Comp.pureEval?), falling back to static k.cost after any sample, query, or monadic loop. ValidKindCosts quantifies over all states s and queries t, bounding per-query-kind work via totalCostByKind (Computational/Proofs/ReductionDsl/KindedCost.lean).

structure OpsL120–128 ↗#

Table of primitive operations over S with semantics eval, step cost cost, and embedded literal size opSize (charged in Expr.size; 0 by default).

structure Ops (S : Sig) where Op : Type dom : Op → Ty S cod : Op → Ty S eval : (o : Op) → (dom o).denote → (cod o).denote cost : Op → ℕ opSize : Op → ℕ := fun _ => 0

def Ops.sumL130–139 ↗#

Disjoint union of two operation tables over S.

def Ops.sum (O₁ O₂ : Ops S) : Ops S where Op := O₁.Op ⊕ O₂.Op dom := Sum.elim O₁.dom O₂.dom cod := Sum.elim O₁.cod O₂.cod eval := fun o => match o with | .inl o => O₁.eval o | .inr o => O₂.eval o cost := Sum.elim O₁.cost O₂.cost opSize := Sum.elim O₁.opSize O₂.opSize

def bitsL141–142 ↗#

Bit-length cost ⌊log₂ n⌋ + 1 of a natural-number literal or constant operand n.

def bits (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.log 2 n + 1

def Ty.FitsL144–157 ↗#

Recursive size bound B on a value: S.sz b x ≤ B on base sorts, bits n ≤ B on .nat, length and element bounds on .list, and pointwise bounds on .tbl.

def Ty.Fits (B : ℕ) : (t : Ty S) → t.denote → Prop | .base b, x => S.sz b x ≤ B | .unit, _ => True | .bool, _ => True | .nat, n => bits n ≤ B | .opt _, none => True | .opt t, some a => t.Fits B a | .prod t u, x => t.Fits B x.1 ∧ u.Fits B x.2 | .sum t _, .inl a => t.Fits B a | .sum _ u, .inr b => u.Fits B b | .list t, l => l.length ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, t.Fits B x | .tbl t, m => ∀ i, t.Fits B (m i)

abbrev ValFitsL159–160 ↗#

abbrev ValFits {S : Sig} (B : ℕ) : (t : Ty S) → t.denote → Prop := Ty.Fits B

def OpsSizeHonestL162–166 ↗#

Size-honesty obligation on O: every operator o grows the Ty.Fits bound B by at most O.cost o.

def OpsSizeHonest (O : Ops S) : Prop := ∀ o x B, (O.dom o).Fits B x → (O.cod o).Fits (B + O.cost o) (O.eval o x)

inductive CompL521–545 ↗#

Monadic programs over O and I: pure returns, sequencing, branching, sampling, target queries, and statically bounded loops (n iterations or at most the first K list entries).

inductive Comp (O : Ops S) (I : Iface S T) : List (Ty S) → Ty S → Type | ret {Γ t} : Expr O Γ t → Comp O I Γ t | bind {Γ t u} : Comp O I Γ t → Comp O I (t :: Γ) u → Comp O I Γ u | ite {Γ t} : Expr O Γ .bool → Comp O I Γ t → Comp O I Γ t → Comp O I Γ t | caseOpt {Γ t u} : Expr O Γ (.opt t) → Comp O I Γ u → Comp O I (t :: Γ) u → Comp O I Γ u | caseSum {Γ t u v} : Expr O Γ (.sum t u) → Comp O I (t :: Γ) v → Comp O I (u :: Γ) v → Comp O I Γ v | sample {Γ} (s : I.smp.Samp) : Expr O Γ (I.smp.sDom s) → Comp O I Γ (I.smp.sTy s) | query {Γ} (g : I.Tag) : Expr O Γ (I.dom g) → Comp O I Γ (I.cod g) /-- Runs `n` iterations of `body` from initial accumulator `init` (bound at `v0`). -/ | iter {Γ t} (n : ℕ) : Expr O Γ t → Comp O I (t :: Γ) t → Comp O I Γ t /-- Short-circuiting monadic search over the first `K` entries. -/ | findM {Γ t} (K : ℕ) : Expr O Γ (.list t) → Comp O I (t :: Γ) .bool → Comp O I Γ (.opt t) /-- Short-circuiting monadic existential check over the first `K` entries. -/ | anyM {Γ t} (K : ℕ) : Expr O Γ (.list t) → Comp O I (t :: Γ) .bool → Comp O I Γ .bool | mapM {Γ t u} (K : ℕ) : Expr O Γ (.list t) → Comp O I (t :: Γ) u → Comp O I Γ (.list u) /-- Replaces the first among the first `K` entries passing the test with `mark` of it; yields `(found, updatedPrefix)`. -/ | consumeFirstM {Γ t} (K : ℕ) : Expr O Γ (.list t) → Comp O I (t :: Γ) .bool → Expr O (t :: Γ) t → Comp O I Γ (.prod .bool (.list t)) /-- Monadic left fold over the first `K` entries (entry bound at `v0`, accumulator at `v1`). -/ | foldM {Γ t u} (K : ℕ) : Expr O Γ (.list t) → Expr O Γ u → Comp O I (t :: u :: Γ) u → Comp O I Γ u

def iterML547–549 ↗#

def iterM {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α : Type} (f : α → m α) : ℕ → α → m α | 0, a => pure a | n + 1, a => f a >>= iterM f n

def findMLL551–553 ↗#

def findML {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) : List α → m (Option α) | [] => pure Option.none | x :: xs => do if ← p x then pure (Option.some x) else findML p xs

def anyMLL555–557 ↗#

def anyML {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) : List α → m Bool | [] => pure false | x :: xs => do if ← p x then pure true else anyML p xs

def mapMLL559–561 ↗#

def mapML {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α β : Type} (f : α → m β) : List α → m (List β) | [] => pure [] | x :: xs => do let y ← f x; let ys ← mapML f xs; pure (y :: ys)

def consumeFirstMLL563–569 ↗#

Short-circuiting replacement of the first entry passing p by mark of it.

def consumeFirstML {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α : Type} (p : α → m Bool) (mark : α → α) : List α → m (Bool × List α) | [] => pure (false, []) | x :: xs => do if ← p x then pure (true, mark x :: xs) else do let r ← consumeFirstML p mark xs; pure (r.1, x :: r.2)

def foldMLL571–573 ↗#

def foldML {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] {α β : Type} (f : α → β → m β) : β → List α → m β | b, [] => pure b | b, x :: xs => do let b' ← f x b; foldML f b' xs

def Comp.evalL575–598 ↗#

Interprets a Comp program into OracleComp T.

def Comp.eval : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Comp O I Γ t → Env Γ → OracleComp T t.denote | _, _, .ret e, ρ => pure (e.eval ρ) | _, _, .bind c k, ρ => c.eval ρ >>= fun x => k.eval (.cons x ρ) | _, _, .ite b c d, ρ => if b.eval ρ then c.eval ρ else d.eval ρ | _, _, .caseOpt e n s, ρ => match e.eval ρ with | Option.none => n.eval ρ | Option.some x => s.eval (.cons x ρ) | _, _, .caseSum e l r, ρ => match e.eval ρ with | Sum.inl x => l.eval (.cons x ρ) | Sum.inr y => r.eval (.cons y ρ) | _, _, .sample s e, ρ => I.liftP (I.smp.samp s (e.eval ρ)) | _, _, .query g e, ρ => let x := e.eval ρ I.dec g x <$> (liftM (T.query (I.enc g x)) : OracleComp T _) | _, _, .iter n e body, ρ => iterM (fun a => body.eval (.cons a ρ)) n (e.eval ρ) | _, _, .findM K l p, ρ => findML (fun x => p.eval (.cons x ρ)) ((l.eval ρ).take K) | _, _, .anyM K l p, ρ => anyML (fun x => p.eval (.cons x ρ)) ((l.eval ρ).take K) | _, _, .mapM K l f, ρ => mapML (fun x => f.eval (.cons x ρ)) ((l.eval ρ).take K) | _, _, .consumeFirstM K l p mk, ρ => consumeFirstML (fun x => p.eval (.cons x ρ)) (fun x => mk.eval (.cons x ρ)) ((l.eval ρ).take K) | _, _, .foldM K l z f, ρ => foldML (fun x acc => f.eval (.cons x (.cons acc ρ))) (z.eval ρ) ((l.eval ρ).take K)

def Comp.costL600–615 ↗#

Static step cost of a program: branches charge max of their arms and loops charge n or K times their body.

def Comp.cost : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Comp O I Γ t → ℕ | _, _, .ret e => e.cost + 1 | _, _, .bind c k => c.cost + k.cost + 1 | _, _, .ite b c d => b.cost + max c.cost d.cost + 1 | _, _, .caseOpt e n s => e.cost + max n.cost s.cost + 1 | _, _, .caseSum e l r => e.cost + max l.cost r.cost + 1 | _, _, .sample s e => e.cost + I.smp.sCost s | _, _, .query g e => e.cost + I.qCost g | _, _, .iter n e body => e.cost + n * (body.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .findM K l p => l.cost + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .anyM K l p => l.cost + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .mapM K l f => l.cost + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .consumeFirstM K l p mk => l.cost + K * (p.cost + mk.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .foldM K l z f => l.cost + z.cost + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1

def Comp.queriesL617–632 ↗#

Static weighted upper bound on target queries (w) and samples (ws).

def Comp.queries (w : I.Tag → ℕ) (ws : I.smp.Samp → ℕ) : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Comp O I Γ t → ℕ | _, _, .ret _ => 0 | _, _, .bind c k => c.queries w ws + k.queries w ws | _, _, .ite _ c d => max (c.queries w ws) (d.queries w ws) | _, _, .caseOpt _ n s => max (n.queries w ws) (s.queries w ws) | _, _, .caseSum _ l r => max (l.queries w ws) (r.queries w ws) | _, _, .sample s _ => ws s | _, _, .query g _ => w g | _, _, .iter n _ body => n * body.queries w ws | _, _, .findM K _ p => K * p.queries w ws | _, _, .anyM K _ p => K * p.queries w ws | _, _, .mapM K _ f => K * f.queries w ws | _, _, .consumeFirstM K _ p _ => K * p.queries w ws | _, _, .foldM K _ _ f => K * f.queries w ws

def Comp.sizeL634–649 ↗#

Syntax-tree size of a program: counts both branch arms, each loop body once, and bit-lengths of loop bounds n and K.

def Comp.size : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Comp O I Γ t → ℕ | _, _, .ret e => e.size + 1 | _, _, .bind c k => c.size + k.size + 1 | _, _, .ite b c d => b.size + c.size + d.size + 1 | _, _, .caseOpt e n s => e.size + n.size + s.size + 1 | _, _, .caseSum e l r => e.size + l.size + r.size + 1 | _, _, .sample _ e => e.size + 1 | _, _, .query _ e => e.size + 1 | _, _, .iter n e body => e.size + body.size + bits n + 1 | _, _, .findM K l p => l.size + p.size + bits K + 1 | _, _, .anyM K l p => l.size + p.size + bits K + 1 | _, _, .mapM K l f => l.size + f.size + bits K + 1 | _, _, .consumeFirstM K l p mk => l.size + p.size + mk.size + bits K + 1 | _, _, .foldM K l z f => l.size + z.size + f.size + bits K + 1

structure GameCodecL651–658 ↗#

Encoding of source-game G queries into Q (qenc) and decoding of R values into G answers (rdec), with per-query encoding/decoding overhead codecCost.

structure GameCodec (S : Sig) {κ : Type} (G : OracleSpec κ) where Q : Ty S R : Ty S qenc : (t : κ) → Q.denote rdec : (t : κ) → R.denote → G t codecCost : ℕ
variable {κ : Type} {G : OracleSpec κ} {C : GameCodec S G}

def handlerImplL662–669 ↗#

Simulates unifSpec + G in state σ by forwarding coins via I.fwdU and answering G-queries with h (in context [σ, C.Q]).

def handlerImpl {σ : Ty S} (h : Comp O I [σ, C.Q] (.prod C.R σ)) : QueryImpl (unifSpec + G) (StateT σ.denote (OracleComp T)) := fun q => match q with | .inl n => StateT.lift (I.fwdU n) | .inr t => StateT.mk fun s => do let p ← h.eval (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) return (C.rdec t p.1, p.2)

structure CostedReductionL671–679 ↗#

Single-stage black-box reduction against game G (codec C) with state σ: init maps reduction input rIn to (aIn, σ), handle maps (σ, C.Q) to (C.R, σ), and finish maps (σ, aOut) to out.

structure CostedReduction (O : Ops S) (I : Iface S T) {κ : Type} (G : OracleSpec κ) (C : GameCodec S G) (rIn aIn aOut out : Ty S) where σ : Ty S init : Comp O I [rIn] (.prod aIn σ) handle : Comp O I [σ, C.Q] (.prod C.R σ) finish : Comp O I [σ, aOut] out
variable {rIn aIn aOut out : Ty S}

def CostedReduction.implL683–685 ↗#

def CostedReduction.impl (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) : QueryImpl (unifSpec + G) (StateT R.σ.denote (OracleComp T)) := handlerImpl R.handle

def CostedReduction.evalL687–693 ↗#

Runs reduction R once around adversary A on input x in OracleComp T.

def CostedReduction.eval (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) (A : aIn.denote → OracleComp (unifSpec + G) aOut.denote) (x : rIn.denote) : OracleComp T out.denote := do let (a, s) ← R.init.eval (.cons x .nil) let (b, s') ← (simulateQ R.impl (A a)).run s R.finish.eval (.cons s' (.cons b .nil))

def CostedReduction.totalCostL695–697 ↗#

Upper bound on step cost outside A when A makes at most q total unifSpec + G queries.

def CostedReduction.totalCost (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) (q : ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.cost + q * (max I.uCost (R.handle.cost + C.codecCost)) + R.finish.cost

def CostedReduction.totalQueriesL699–702 ↗#

Weighted upper bound on target queries and samples when A makes at most q G-queries.

def CostedReduction.totalQueries (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) (w : I.Tag → ℕ) (ws : I.smp.Samp → ℕ) (q : ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.queries w ws + q * R.handle.queries w ws + R.finish.queries w ws

def CostedReduction.sizeL704–706 ↗#

Total syntax-tree size of R (init, handle, and finish counted once each).

def CostedReduction.size (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) : ℕ := R.init.size + R.handle.size + R.finish.size

Two-stage reductions

inductive MidL710–714 ↗#

Stage-1 termination state: either A finished (done), or A paused (paused) at query t with stage-1 challenge output c, saved pause data p, state s, and continuation k.

inductive Mid (G : OracleSpec κ) (α π σ χ : Type) where | done (a : α) (s : σ) | paused (t : κ) (c : χ) (p : π) (s : σ) (k : G t → OracleComp (unifSpec + G) α)

structure TwoStageCostedReductionL716–735 ↗#

Two-stage black-box reduction against G (codec C) for a target taking stage-1 output ch and supplying stage-2 input rIn2. In stage 1, handlePre either answers a G-query (inl) or pauses (inr) with (c, p, σ'), and chDone produces c if A finishes without pausing; in stage 2, resume answers the paused query from rIn2, handlePost answers subsequent queries, and finish computes the final output.

In eval1 and eval2, fuel caps G-queries per stage (returning dflt on exhaustion) while coin draws are forwarded without consuming fuel; setting fuel := q when A makes at most q G-queries across both stages makes the fallback unreachable. See eval1Bounded and eval2Bounded for explicit coin and game-query fuel.

structure TwoStageCostedReduction (O : Ops S) (I : Iface S T) {κ : Type} (G : OracleSpec κ) (C : GameCodec S G) (rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out : Ty S) where σ : Ty S π : Ty S init : Comp O I [rIn] (.prod aIn σ) handlePre : Comp O I [σ, C.Q] (.sum (.prod C.R σ) (.prod ch (.prod π σ))) chDone : Comp O I [σ, aOut] ch resume : Comp O I [σ, π, rIn2] (.prod C.R σ) handlePost : Comp O I [σ, C.Q] (.prod C.R σ) finish : Comp O I [σ, aOut, rIn2] out
variable {ch rIn2 : Ty S}

def TwoStageCostedReduction.run1L739–755 ↗#

Runs stage 1 on oa for at most fuel G-queries (coins forwarded via I.fwdU); returns .done dflt s on fuel exhaustion.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.run1 (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) {α : Type} (dflt : α) (oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + G) α) : ℕ → R.σ.denote → OracleComp T (Mid G α R.π.denote R.σ.denote ch.denote) := OracleComp.construct (C := fun _ => ℕ → R.σ.denote → OracleComp T (Mid G α R.π.denote R.σ.denote ch.denote)) (fun a _ s => pure (.done a s)) (fun q k r f s => match q with | .inl n => do let u ← I.fwdU n; r u f s | .inr t => match f with | 0 => pure (.done dflt s) | f + 1 => do match ← R.handlePre.eval (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) with | .inl (v, s') => r (C.rdec t v) f s' | .inr (c, p, s') => pure (.paused t c p s' k)) oa

def runFuelL757–770 ↗#

Runs oa under handler h for at most fuel G-queries (coins forwarded via I.fwdU); returns (dflt, s) on fuel exhaustion.

def runFuel {σ : Ty S} (h : Comp O I [σ, C.Q] (.prod C.R σ)) {α : Type} (dflt : α) (oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + G) α) : ℕ → σ.denote → OracleComp T (α × σ.denote) := OracleComp.construct (C := fun _ => ℕ → σ.denote → OracleComp T (α × σ.denote)) (fun a _ s => pure (a, s)) (fun q _ r f s => match q with | .inl n => do let u ← I.fwdU n; r u f s | .inr t => match f with | 0 => pure (dflt, s) | f + 1 => do let p ← h.eval (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) r (C.rdec t p.1) f p.2) oa

def TwoStageCostedReduction.eval1L772–782 ↗#

Executes stage 1 of R on adversary A and input x with G-query budget fuel and fallback output dflt; yields the target's stage-1 input and Mid state.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.eval1 (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (A : aIn.denote → OracleComp (unifSpec + G) aOut.denote) (x : rIn.denote) (fuel : ℕ) (dflt : aOut.denote) : OracleComp T (ch.denote × Mid G aOut.denote R.π.denote R.σ.denote ch.denote) := do let (a, s) ← R.init.eval (.cons x .nil) let m ← R.run1 dflt (A a) fuel s match m with | .done b s' => do let c ← R.chDone.eval (.cons s' (.cons b .nil)); pure (c, m) | .paused _ c _ _ _ => pure (c, m)

def TwoStageCostedReduction.eval2L784–794 ↗#

Resumes m with stage-2 target input y under G-query budget fuel and fallback dflt, then runs R.finish.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.eval2 (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (m : Mid G aOut.denote R.π.denote R.σ.denote ch.denote) (y : rIn2.denote) (fuel : ℕ) (dflt : aOut.denote) : OracleComp T out.denote := do let (b, s) ← match m with | .done b s => pure (b, s) | .paused t _ p s k => do let (v, s') ← R.resume.eval (.cons s (.cons p (.cons y .nil))) runFuel R.handlePost dflt (k (C.rdec t v)) fuel s' R.finish.eval (.cons s (.cons b (.cons y .nil)))

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalCostL796–800 ↗#

Upper bound on step cost outside A across both stages when A makes at most q total unifSpec + G queries.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalCost (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (q : ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.cost + q * max I.uCost (max R.handlePre.cost R.handlePost.cost + C.codecCost) + max R.chDone.cost R.resume.cost + R.finish.cost

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalQueriesL802–807 ↗#

Weighted upper bound on target queries and samples across both stages when A makes at most q G-queries.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalQueries (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) (w : I.Tag → ℕ) (ws : I.smp.Samp → ℕ) (q : ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.queries w ws + q * max (R.handlePre.queries w ws) (R.handlePost.queries w ws) + max (R.chDone.queries w ws) (R.resume.queries w ws) + R.finish.queries w ws

def TwoStageCostedReduction.sizeL809–812 ↗#

Total syntax-tree size of R across all six stage components, counted once each.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.size (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) : ℕ := R.init.size + R.handlePre.size + R.chDone.size + R.resume.size + R.handlePost.size + R.finish.size

Run-local size premises

def AllGameQueriesFitL816–829 ↗#

Run-local query-size bound: along every execution branch of oa, each game query .inr t satisfies C.Q.Fits B (C.qenc t) (coin queries .inl n are unconstrained). Adapted from an earlier definition by Swarat Chaudhuri.

open OracleSpec OracleComp in def AllGameQueriesFit {κ : Type} {G : OracleSpec κ} (B : ℕ) (C : GameCodec S G) {α : Type} (oa : OracleComp (unifSpec + G) α) : Prop := OracleComp.construct (C := fun _ => Prop) (fun _ => True) (fun q _ r => match q with | .inl _ => ∀ u, r u | .inr t => C.Q.Fits B (C.qenc t) ∧ ∀ u, r u) oa

def supportWhenL831–840 ↗#

Outputs reachable by oa along execution branches where every oracle query t receives an answer u satisfying P t u (equals support oa when P is True).

open OracleSpec OracleComp in def supportWhen {ι' : Type} {spec : OracleSpec ι'} {α : Type} (P : (t : ι') → spec t → Prop) (oa : OracleComp spec α) : Set α := OracleComp.construct (C := fun _ => Set α) (fun a => {a}) (fun t _ r => {y | ∃ u, P t u ∧ y ∈ r u}) oa

def Iface.AnswerFitsL842–846 ↗#

Run-local answer-size predicate: target answer u : T i decodes within Ty.Fits B under every tag g and input x with I.enc g x = i.

def Iface.AnswerFits (I : Iface S T) (B : ℕ) (i : ι) (u : T i) : Prop := ∀ (g : I.Tag) (x : (I.dom g).denote) (h : I.enc g x = i), (I.cod g).Fits B (I.dec g x (cast (congrArg T h).symm u))

def Expr.costAt : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Expr O Γ t → Env Γ → ℕ | _, _, .var _, _ => 1 | _, _, .unit, _ => 1 | _, _, .bool _, _ => 1 | _, _, .nat n, _ => bits n | _, _, .add a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .sub a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .mulK k a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + bits k | _, _, .divK k a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + bits k | _, _, .modK k a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + bits k | _, _, .lt a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .eqN a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .not a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .and a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .ite c a b, ρ => c.costAt ρ + (if c.eval ρ then a.costAt ρ else b.costAt ρ) + 1 | _, _, .pair a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .fst a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .snd a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .inl a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .inr a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .none, _ => 1 | _, _, .some a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .caseOpt e n s, ρ => e.costAt ρ + (match e.eval ρ with | Option.none => n.costAt ρ | Option.some x => s.costAt (.cons x ρ)) + 1 | _, _, .caseSum e l r, ρ => e.costAt ρ + (match e.eval ρ with | Sum.inl x => l.costAt (.cons x ρ) | Sum.inr y => r.costAt (.cons y ρ)) + 1 | _, _, .letE e b, ρ => e.costAt ρ + b.costAt (.cons (e.eval ρ) ρ) + 1 | _, _, .op o a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + O.cost o | _, _, .nil, _ => 1 | _, _, .cons x l, ρ => x.costAt ρ + l.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .len l, ρ => l.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .take n l, ρ => n.costAt ρ + l.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .appendL K a b, ρ => a.costAt ρ + b.costAt ρ + K + 1 | _, _, .findB K l p, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .anyB K l p, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .mapB K l f, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .foldrB K l z f, ρ => l.costAt ρ + z.costAt ρ + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .tconst a, ρ => a.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .tget m i, ρ => m.costAt ρ + i.costAt ρ + 64 | _, _, .tset m i a, ρ => m.costAt ρ + i.costAt ρ + a.costAt ρ + 128

Evaluates an effect-free prefix of c in ρ; returns none if execution reaches a sample, target query, or monadic loop.

(.cons x ρ) | _, _, .ite b c d, ρ => if b.eval ρ then c.pureEval? ρ else d.pureEval? ρ | _, _, .caseOpt e n s, ρ => match e.eval ρ with | Option.none => n.pureEval? ρ | Option.some x => s.pureEval? (.cons x ρ) | _, _, .caseSum e l r, ρ => match e.eval ρ with | Sum.inl x => l.pureEval? (.cons x ρ) | Sum.inr y => r.pureEval? def Comp.costAtL919–944 ↗#

Input-specialized cost of running c in ρ: branches charge only the arm taken at ρ, bind specializes its continuation when c.pureEval? ρ = some x (and charges static k.cost otherwise), and loops charge static body .cost.

def Comp.costAt : {Γ : List (Ty S)} → {t : Ty S} → Comp O I Γ t → Env Γ → ℕ | _, _, .ret e, ρ => e.costAt ρ + 1 | _, _, .bind c k, ρ => c.costAt ρ + (match c.pureEval? ρ with | Option.some x => k.costAt (.cons x ρ) | Option.none => k.cost) + 1 | _, _, .ite b c d, ρ => b.costAt ρ + (if b.eval ρ then c.costAt ρ else d.costAt ρ) + 1 | _, _, .caseOpt e n s, ρ => e.costAt ρ + (match e.eval ρ with | Option.none => n.costAt ρ | Option.some x => s.costAt (.cons x ρ)) + 1 | _, _, .caseSum e l r, ρ => e.costAt ρ + (match e.eval ρ with | Sum.inl x => l.costAt (.cons x ρ) | Sum.inr y => r.costAt (.cons y ρ)) + 1 | _, _, .sample s e, ρ => e.costAt ρ + I.smp.sCost s | _, _, .query g e, ρ => e.costAt ρ + I.qCost g | _, _, .iter n e body, ρ => e.costAt ρ + n * (body.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .findM K l p, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .anyM K l p, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (p.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .mapM K l f, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .consumeFirstM K l p mk, ρ => l.costAt ρ + K * (p.cost + mk.cost + 1) + 1 | _, _, .foldM K l z f, ρ => l.costAt ρ + z.costAt ρ + K * (f.cost + 1) + 1

def CostedReduction.ValidKindCostsL946–951 ↗#

Per-kind handler cost bound: from any state s, handling game query t costs at most hCost (kind t) under costAt.

def CostedReduction.ValidKindCosts (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) {n : ℕ} (kind : κ → Fin n) (hCost : Fin n → ℕ) : Prop := ∀ (s : R.σ.denote) (t : κ), R.handle.costAt (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) ≤ hCost (kind t)

def CostedReduction.totalCostByKindL953–960 ↗#

Step-cost bound outside A when A's G-queries are partitioned into n kinds with at most qKind i queries and handler cost hCost i for kind i (forwarded coin draws are not counted in qKind).

def CostedReduction.totalCostByKind (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) {n : ℕ} (hCost qKind : Fin n → ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.cost + (List.ofFn fun i => qKind i * max I.uCost (hCost i + C.codecCost)).sum + R.finish.cost

def CostedReduction.CostBoundedByKindL962–965 ↗#

Existence of valid per-kind handler cost bounds hCost with R.totalCostByKind hCost qKind ≤ B.

def CostedReduction.CostBoundedByKind (R : CostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut out) {n : ℕ} (kind : κ → Fin n) (qKind : Fin n → ℕ) (B : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ hCost : Fin n → ℕ, R.ValidKindCosts kind hCost ∧ R.totalCostByKind hCost qKind ≤ B

def TwoStageCostedReduction.ValidKindCostsL967–973 ↗#

Two-stage per-kind handler cost bound covering both handlePre and handlePost.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.ValidKindCosts (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) {n : ℕ} (kind : κ → Fin n) (hCost : Fin n → ℕ) : Prop := ∀ (s : R.σ.denote) (t : κ), R.handlePre.costAt (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) ≤ hCost (kind t) ∧ R.handlePost.costAt (.cons s (.cons (C.qenc t) .nil)) ≤ hCost (kind t)

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalCostByKindL975–982 ↗#

Step-cost bound outside A across both stages when A makes at most qKind i G-queries of kind i in total (forwarded coin draws are not counted in qKind).

def TwoStageCostedReduction.totalCostByKind (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) {n : ℕ} (hCost qKind : Fin n → ℕ) : ℕ := R.init.cost + (List.ofFn fun i => qKind i * max I.uCost (hCost i + C.codecCost)).sum + max R.chDone.cost R.resume.cost + R.finish.cost

def TwoStageCostedReduction.CostBoundedByKindL984–988 ↗#

Two-stage counterpart of CostedReduction.CostBoundedByKind.

def TwoStageCostedReduction.CostBoundedByKind (R : TwoStageCostedReduction O I G C rIn aIn aOut ch rIn2 out) {n : ℕ} (kind : κ → Fin n) (qKind : Fin n → ℕ) (B : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ hCost : Fin n → ℕ, R.ValidKindCosts kind hCost ∧ R.totalCostByKind hCost qKind ≤ B
